data.long_meaning: Mrinal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mrn', meaning 'jewel' or 'precious'. It is also a name for the moon god, Chandra, as he is considered the jewel of the universe. The name Mrinal carries the meaning “Jewel, precious gem” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mrinal usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious gem and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: Mrinal is a spiritually significant name as it is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mrn', which translates to 'jewel'. In Hinduism, the term 'jewel' can refer to various aspects of the divine, such as a precious gem or a soul. The name emphasizes the inherent worth and value of the individual, reminding them that they are a divine embodiment and possess great value both in the eyes of the universe and their own soul. Additionally, as a name of Chandra, Mrinal carries the energies and influences of the moon god, associated with wisdom, inner wisdom, and emotional depth.
